description: Quick-add tags are no longer lowercased, so '#Bug' and '#bug' become two tags. tags.py (which has normalize_tag) is a decoy: its code is correct.
report_specific: parse_quick_add('Fix login #Bug #bug') returns the tags ['Bug', 'bug']. Tags should be lowercase with duplicates removed, so the expected result is ['bug'].
report_vague: When people type a tag with a capital letter in the quick add box we get two copies of the same tag, and filtering by tag misses some tasks.

decoys.why: the real lowercasing helper, correct and unused here
